akagawa_bucket: The draft reached R-S6 on Day 7. Norbert Bucket was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Norbert Bucket (Concord) and Zeno Smiridisnick (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Blackwater Canal for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Bucket measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong. A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.
royalcanadianmatt: After 9 days of war, S-C6 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Dorian Royalcanadia.
t_camper_13: The sergeant gave Jakub "Shadow" Camper a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 4 or any other.
Jakub "Shadow" Camper agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F3 and grazed Jakub "Shadow" Camper's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210). The Hegemony won Hill 304. In S-F3, Jakub "Shadow" Camper listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jakub "Shadow" Camper is whole again, or near enough for the line.
The artist tried again while Jakub "Shadow" Camper read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
A bullet clipped Jakub "Shadow" Camper's helmet at S-F3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Silas Hansen of the Hegemony (@mikkel.hansen27).

A bullet went through Jakub "Shadow" Camper's upper arm at S-F3 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210). Jakub "Shadow" Camper was killed outright at S-F3, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).
Ivo Camper took the same post at S-F3 where Jakub "Shadow" Camper stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
vic_jul11: Gustav "Tin" Jul found a place in S-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
One of the first hundred, Gustav "Tin" Jul was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Gustav "Tin" Jul's transfer to the role of chaplain was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
The sky stayed clear above S-F10. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched a small cloud form and quietly hoped it would bring friends.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Anselm "Parson" Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav "Tin" Jul kicked it back. It did not come again.

A shouted challenge from Yann Vee (Concord) reached Gustav "Tin" Jul (Hegemony) at the Drowned Farm. The answer was lost beneath the guns. The challenge was not repeated. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The guns found S-F10. Gustav "Tin" Jul was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
No bed for Gustav "Tin" Jul yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.

Gustav "Tin" Jul lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Gustav "Tin" Jul did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

There was never a bed for Gustav "Tin" Jul, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F10 on his own feet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Gustav "Tin" Jul in the open at S-F10. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Day of the Concord (@selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0). Gustav "Tin" Jul finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Gustav "Tin" Jul is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.

The stretcher Gustav "Tin" Jul lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Gustav "Tin" Jul is back at S-F10, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav "Tin" Jul reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F10 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord (@vuminhtri260709). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
